name: Raffles Maldives Meradhoo Resort
insider_take: This ultra-luxe resort occupies two pristine islands in the remote Gaafu Alifu Atoll, offering unparalleled privacy where you're likely one of only 38 villas across 54 acres of untouched paradise.
whats_special: Raffles Maldives is built on dual islands connected by a 200-meter walkway - one dedicated to beach villas, the other to overwater sanctuaries. The resort features the Maldives' first overwater spa pavilion and sits in one of the deepest atolls in the archipelago, making it a world-class diving destination with dramatic drop-offs just steps from shore.
pro_tip: Book the Raffles Royal Residence - it's the largest overwater villa in the Maldives at 5,500 square feet, complete with its own butler and private speedboat for ultimate island-hopping adventures.
dont_miss: The resort's signature "Dine by Design" experiences, including sunset dining on a remote sandbank and underwater restaurant access via seaplane. The house reef here is exceptional - you can snorkel directly from your villa and spot manta rays, whale sharks, and over 1,000 species of fish in the crystal-clear waters of this UNESCO Biosphere Reserve.
pros: Ultra-luxurious overwater and beach villas with private pools
Pristine location on two islands connected by scenic walkways
World-class diving and snorkeling in crystal-clear waters
Exceptional personalized service with dedicated villa hosts
cons: Remote island location requires seaplane transfers
Ultra-premium pricing reflects exclusive luxury positioning
